text: 谢邀。
en: Thank you for the invitation.

text: 人到中年，上有老下有小，经历过世事风霜，许多事情早已看的明白。
en: Having reached middle age, with elderly parents to care for above and young children below, and having weathered the vicissitudes of life, one has long since come to see many things clearly.

text: 分享一些社会生存法则，供有缘人参考。
en: I would like to share some rules for getting by in society, for anyone who chances upon them to consider.

text: 1、管好自己的嘴，不要四处炫耀，不要随便哭诉，更不要心直口快。
en: 1. Keep your mouth in check — do not show off everywhere, do not pour out your troubles to just anyone, and certainly do not be blunt and tactless.

text: 因为身边的人，是人是鬼，你都是看不清的，包括自己的亲人。
en: For the people around you, whether they are good or bad, you can never truly see through them, not even your own kin.

text: 正所谓是：画虎画皮难画骨，知人知面不知心。
en: As the old saying goes: it is easy to paint a tiger's skin but hard to paint its bones; you may know a person's face but not their heart.

text: 2、在熟人面前装穷，在陌生人面前装富。
en: 2. Put on a show of poverty before acquaintances, and a show of wealth before strangers.

text: 因为熟人之间的嫉妒心最强，背后捅刀子的，都是熟人；而陌生人之间大都是以貌取人、嫌贫爱富，所以你要以强者姿态示人。
en: Because jealousy runs strongest among acquaintances, and those who stab you in the back are always acquaintances; whereas between strangers, most judge by appearances and look down on the poor while favouring the rich — so you must present yourself from a position of strength.

text: 3、不要做一个任劳任怨的老好人，而是要做一个有实力、不好惹的人，因为人都是欺软怕硬的。
en: 3. Do not be a self-sacrificing pushover; rather, be a capable person not to be trifled with, because people always bully the weak and fear the strong.

text: 人善被人欺，马善被人欺，只有当你足够强大或者不好惹的时候，人家才会把你当回事，甚至是怕你。
en: The kind are taken advantage of, as are the docile — only when you are strong enough or not to be trifled with will others take you seriously, even fear you.

text: 4、不轻易相信他人，也不随便说大话，就如古语所说：诺不轻信，则人不负我；诺不轻许，则我不负人。
en: 4. Do not place your trust in others too readily, nor make careless boasts, just as the ancient saying goes: if you do not trust promises lightly, no one will fail you; if you do not make promises lightly, you will fail no one.

text: 很多时候，别人的话只是客套话，不可随便当真；但是你自己说出去的话，别人又特别喜欢当真。
en: More often than not, what others say is mere pleasantry, not to be taken at face value; yet the words that come out of your own mouth, others are all too ready to take seriously.

text: 所以说，中年人要多听少说，沉默是金，看透不说透，大家还是好朋友。
en: Therefore, those in middle age should listen more and speak less — silence is golden; understand things without laying them bare, and everyone stays good friends.

text: 5、很长时间没有联系你的朋友、同学、同事，不管他多么热情，如何打感情牌，你都要多留个心眼，防人之心不可无。
en: 5. Friends, classmates or colleagues who have not been in touch for a long time — however warm they seem, however much they play on your feelings, you must stay that bit more wary, for one can never be too guarded against others.

text: 更何况老祖宗早就告诫我们：无事献殷勤，非奸即盗。
en: Besides, our ancestors long ago warned us: unsolicited attentiveness means ill intent — it comes from either a scoundrel or a thief.

text: 如果对方找你借钱，或者想赚你的钱，让你投资某个项目，直接拒绝，不要怕得罪人，大不了又再不联系了。
en: If the other party asks to borrow money, or wants to make money off you, or persuades you to invest in some project, refuse outright. Do not fear giving offence; at worst you simply stop contacting each other again.

text: 6、脸皮要厚点，要懂点人情世故，甚至是习惯性送礼，或求人办事，或联络感情。
en: 6. Have a thicker skin, learn a little about the ways of the world, and even get into the habit of giving gifts — whether to ask favours, to keep in touch, or to build rapport.

text: 比如说，你求大佬帮你忙，要真金白银表示，而不是廉价的“谢谢”；你去亲戚朋友家玩，一定不能空着手，多少也要提点东西。
en: For instance, when you ask a big shot for help, show real money rather than a cheap 'thank you'; when you visit relatives or friends, you must never go empty-handed — bring something, however little.

text: 7、要多赞美他人的长处，不说批评别人的话，更不能背后说人坏话。
en: 7. Praise others' strengths more often, refrain from criticism, and all the more never speak ill of people behind their backs.

text: 因为口是福祸之门，很多时候，就是因为管不住嘴，说错了话，最后给自己带来很大麻烦。
en: For the mouth is the gateway of fortune and misfortune; many a time, it is precisely because one cannot control one's mouth and says the wrong thing that great trouble is brought upon oneself in the end.

text: 但是赞美他人的话，往往可以让他人对你的好感迅猛提升，最后事半功倍，正所谓是：干得好不如说得好。
en: Yet words of praise can often make others warm to you remarkably quickly, so that your efforts pay off handsomely — just as the saying goes: speaking well beats doing well.

text: 8、要懂得放弃面子，放弃尊严去努力赚钱，因为面子不是别人给的，而是你自己用实力挣来的。
en: 8. Learn to set aside pride and dignity and strive to earn money, because face is not given by others but earned by your own ability.

text: 就如某位企业家所说：当你放下面子赚钱的时候，说明你已经懂事了；当你用钱赚回面子的时候，说明你已经成功了。
en: As a certain entrepreneur once said: when you put down your pride to earn money, it shows you have grown up; when you use money to win back your pride, it shows you have succeeded.

text: 本人从事易/学咨询以来，已累计预测分析上万命例，为许多朋友提供过婚恋交友、职业规划等方面的专业咨询建议，帮助他们走出迷茫，摆脱人生困境。
en: Since I began offering consultations in I Ching studies, I have analysed and predicted well over ten thousand destiny readings, and given many friends professional advice on matters such as romance and relationships and career planning, helping them find their way out of confusion and escape life's predicaments.

text: 易/学博大精深，我只是易/学海洋里的一叶小舟。
en: I Ching studies are profound and vast; I am but a tiny boat in the ocean of I Ching studies.

text: 先讲一个男孩的故事。
en: First, let me tell you the story of a boy.

text: 他出生在山东菏泽一个农村家庭。
en: He was born into a rural family in Heze, Shandong.

text: 小时候不爱学习，每次就考15分，20分。
en: As a child he disliked studying, and would score only 15 or 20 marks each time.

text: 但好在有一个暴富的爸爸。
en: But luckily he had a father who had struck it rich.

text: 不想上学，爸爸就拿钱哄他，让他去学校。
en: When he did not want to go to school, his father would coax him with money into going.

text: 等他到14岁的时候，连去学校混日子也懒得去了，直接就辍学了。
en: By the time he was 14, he could not even be bothered to go to school just to while away the days, and simply dropped out.

text: 他心想：念不念书无所谓，反正家里有钱。
en: He thought to himself: whether or not I study makes no difference; my family has money anyway.

text: 他爸的反应同样是：不想念就算了，反正我家有钱。
en: His father's reaction was much the same: if you don't want to study, so be it; my family has money anyway.

text: 也没想过把儿子送出去学个技术，以后有个养家糊口的本领。
en: He never thought to send his son away to learn a trade, so that he might have a means of supporting a family later on.

text: 辍学后，男孩每天待在家里没日没夜地打游戏，换别人家肯定急疯了，可他爸爸依旧很淡定：
en: After dropping out, the boy stayed at home playing video games day and night; any other family would have been driven frantic, but his father remained perfectly calm:

text: “在家种地也可以，找个通情达理的媳妇，过完这一辈子就行了。
en: “Tilling the land at home is fine too — just find yourself a sensible wife and live out the rest of your life.

text: 就这样，男孩在家当了5年小皇帝，从稚嫩少年堕落成了大腹便便的油腻青年。
en: And so the boy played little emperor at home for five years, degenerating from a tender youth into a portly, greasy young man.

text: 19岁时，还没到法定结婚年龄，他爸就按计划给他安排了一桩婚事，连彩礼也为他准备好了。
en: At 19, before he had even reached the legal marriage age, his father arranged a match for him as planned, and even prepared the bride price.

text: 一沓沓现金，房子、奔驰车、金饰，花了百万。
en: Stacks of cash, a house, a Mercedes-Benz and gold ornaments — it cost a million.

text: 但这段婚姻仅维持了一年，离婚后前妻直言：
en: But this marriage lasted only a year, and after the divorce his ex-wife said bluntly:

text: “我只是选中了他的家世，现实中哪一个不是这样？
en: “I only chose him for his family background; in real life, who isn't like that?

text: 离婚后的他，买衣服、理发都跟在父亲后面，等着父亲结账。
en: After the divorce, he would follow his father when buying clothes or getting a haircut, waiting for his father to pay.

text: 说到这，相信你们知道是谁了，就是大衣哥朱之文的儿子，朱单伟。
en: By now you surely know who this is — he is Danwei Zhu, the son of Overcoat Brother Zhiwen Zhu.

text: 让人没想到的是，不到一年时间，朱单伟又被曝出订婚了。
en: What no one expected was that, less than a year later, Danwei Zhu was again reported to be engaged.

text: 为了这次婚事，他爸依旧豪掷千金。
en: For this marriage too, his father once again spent a fortune.

text: 订婚当天，直接送一辆宝马。
en: On the day of the engagement, he was given a BMW on the spot.

text: 有人说，朱单伟是幸运的，有爸爸一直给他托底，不上学、不工作、不努力，他照样可以过得很好。
en: Some say Danwei Zhu is lucky, with a father who always cushions him — no schooling, no work, no effort, and he can still live well.

text: 事实上真的如此吗？
en: But is that really the case?

text: 再给大家讲下一个小男孩的故事。
en: Let me tell you the story of another little boy.

text: 这个男孩出生于湖南宁乡一个贫穷的小乡村，村民住的土坯房水一冲就塌。
en: This boy was born in a poor little village in Ningxiang, Hunan, where the villagers' rammed-earth houses would collapse at the touch of flowing water.

text: 他家更是连一个像样的家具都没有，睡觉铺的是一床稻草。
en: His own home did not even have a decent piece of furniture; he slept on a bed of straw.

text: 连练习本都买不起，通常写完一本就把字擦掉，继续用。
en: He could not even afford exercise books, and would usually erase what he had written once a book was filled and use it again.

text: 每天放学，别人的孩子在外面玩，他被关在屋里写作业。
en: Every day after school, while other children played outside, he was kept indoors to do his homework.

text: 晚饭后，别的家长打牌消遣，唯独他的父母陪着他读书。
en: After supper, while other parents played cards for amusement, his parents alone kept him company as he studied.

text: 在这样艰苦的条件下，他没有辍学，没有堕落，一路读到了哈佛。
en: Under such harsh conditions, he did not drop out, nor did he degenerate, but studied all the way to Harvard.

text: 他就是第一个在哈佛毕业典礼演讲的中国人，何江。
en: He is Jiang He, the first Chinese person to speak at Harvard's commencement ceremony.

text: 与他同台演讲的，还有著名导演斯皮尔伯格。
en: Sharing the stage with him was the renowned director Spielberg.

text: 回忆起父母对他的教育，他说：
en: Recalling his parents' upbringing, he said:

text: “如果没有父母的陪伴和坚持，我估计像童年很多小伙伴一样，没读几年书，就早早外出打工了。
en: “If not for my parents' company and perseverance, I expect I would have been like many of my childhood friends — having studied only a few years, I would have gone away to work at an early age.

text: 教育学上有个“剪刀效应”。
en: In education there is a concept known as the 'scissors effect'.

text: 讲的是，每个孩子小的时候，可能只有一点儿差异。
en: It holds that when children are small, they may differ only slightly.

text: 但经过不一样的教育方式，最终导致了成年后的巨大差距。
en: Yet different styles of upbringing ultimately lead to enormous gaps in adulthood.

text: 父母不一样的陪伴和引领，最终造就的是孩子天差地别的未来。
en: The different company and guidance of parents ultimately shape futures for their children that are worlds apart.

text: 朱单伟的爸爸给了孩子优渥的生活，却没能教给他创造生活的能力。
en: Danwei Zhu's father gave his son a comfortable life, but failed to teach him the ability to create a life of his own.

text: 何江的父母虽然没能给他安逸舒适的避风港，但却给他插上了独立坚强的翅膀。
en: Jiang He's parents could not give him a snug and comfortable haven, yet they equipped him with the wings of independence and resilience.

text: 他俩截然不同的命运，让我想起昨天看到的一则视频。
en: The two utterly different fates reminded me of a video I watched yesterday.

text: 视频里，一位妈妈一直骗儿子家里劳斯莱斯是高仿的，才八万块钱。
en: In the video, a mother keeps telling her son that their Rolls-Royce is a high-quality fake, worth only eighty thousand yuan.

text: 直到四年后，男孩长大一些，才发现妈妈说谎，自家劳斯莱斯是真的。
en: It was not until four years later, when the boy had grown a little, that he discovered his mother's lie — their Rolls-Royce was genuine.

text: 这位妈妈之所以说谎，是不想因为家庭的富有，就让儿子产生异于他人的优越感；更不想儿子因为家庭富有，形成不劳而获的惰性。
en: The reason this mother lied was that she did not want her son, because of the family's wealth, to develop a sense of superiority over others; still less did she want him, because of that wealth, to form the indolence of one who expects something for nothing.

text: 美国《商业周刊》出版的25个最佳观念专题报道，开始的第一句话就是：
en: The first line of the feature '25 Best Ideas', published by the American magazine BusinessWeek, reads:

text: 好好待你的小孩，但不要给他们太多财产。
en: Be good to your children, but do not give them too much property.

text: 财多伤子，孩子的人生，终究是要自己过的。
en: Too much wealth harms the child; a child's life is, in the end, their own to live.

text: 如果家长一味地在物质上富养孩子，轻则养出一个巨婴，重则害孩子一生。
en: If parents indulge in nurturing their child materially without restraint, the mild outcome is a giant baby, the severe one is ruining the child for life.

text: 还记得南京一派出所发生的那场闹剧吗？
en: Do you still remember that farce at a police station in Nanjing?

text: 父亲花了几百万让儿子留学，儿子学成归来，还给他置办了一套房子，四辆车子。
en: A father spent several million getting his son to study abroad; when the son returned, degree in hand, the father even bought him a flat and four cars.

text: 没想到，原本好好的一个“海归”，却整天缩在家里啃老，一啃就是10年。
en: Unexpectedly, this perfectly good 'returnee from overseas' holed up at home sponging off his parents all day — and went on sponging for ten years.

text: 父亲恨铁不成钢，一气之下把给儿子买的豪车卖了。
en: Exasperated that his son would not shape up, the father, in a fit of anger, sold the luxury car he had bought his son.

text: 儿子得知后竟然把父亲的车给砸了。
en: On learning this, the son actually went and smashed his father's car.

text: 最终，父子俩闹得不可开交，情绪激动之下，儿子甚至扬言要砍父亲。
en: In the end, father and son fell into irreconcilable conflict, and in a moment of high emotion the son even threatened to hack his father.

text: 网上有句很火的话：
en: There is a line that is very popular online:

text: “你以为孩子是来报恩的，其实是来对账的。
en: “You think the child has come to repay your kindness, but in fact they have come to settle accounts.

text: 养好了，你和孩子是股东关系，余生都在享受红利；
en: Raise them well, and you and your child are in a shareholder relationship, enjoying the dividends for the rest of your lives;

text: 养废了，你和孩子是债务关系，不停为他善后还债。
en: Raise them badly, and you and your child are in a debtor relationship, endlessly cleaning up after them and repaying their debts.

text: 孩子的问题，最初都是父母的问题。
en: A child's problems are, at root, the parents' problems.

text: 6岁时，你没教会孩子系鞋带，直到20岁时他自己学会了。
en: At six, you did not teach your child to tie their shoelaces, and they only learnt on their own at twenty.

text: 但20岁明明是该步入职场的年纪，他却只学会了系鞋带。
en: But twenty is the age when one should be entering the workforce, and all they had learnt was to tie their shoelaces.

text: 作家沙拉在《特别狠心特别爱》中写得很有道理：
en: The writer Shala makes a very sound point in her book 'Especially Ruthless, Especially Loving':

text: “中国父母给予孩子的爱，不是太少，而是太多了。
en: “The love Chinese parents give their children is not too little, but too much.

text: 因为不忍心孩子从小体验生活的艰难，也不懂得适当时机向他们索要，最终导致他们一辈子艰辛，一辈子向父母索要。
en: Because they cannot bear to let their children experience hardship from an early age, and do not know how to ask something of them at the right moment, they ultimately condemn them to a lifetime of hardship, a lifetime of demanding from their parents.

text: 我表叔，一个普通的农村工人，赚钱很辛苦，常年住在工地上，连个像样的厕所都没有，而他却给予儿子最好的物质条件。
en: My cousin-uncle, an ordinary rural worker, earns his money through hard toil, living year-round on a construction site without even a proper toilet, yet he gave his son the very best material comforts.

text: 有一次小表弟来我家吃饭，我妈做了很多家常菜，还特意炖了牛肉，但他一口也不吃，哭着吵着要我妈带他去西餐厅吃牛排。
en: Once my little cousin came to my house for a meal; my mother cooked many home-style dishes and even specially stewed some beef, but he would not eat a bite, crying and fussing for my mother to take him to a Western restaurant for steak.

text: 说我表叔经常带他去。
en: He said my cousin-uncle often took him there.

text: 那一刻我就叹气，我这个小表弟怕是要给养废了。
en: At that moment I sighed — I feared this little cousin of mine was going to be spoilt rotten.

text: 南京师范大学郦波教授说：
en: Professor Bo Li of Nanjing Normal University says:

text: “这是一个全民富二代的时代，我们指责富二代的行为失当，但其实，我们都是富二代的践行者。
en: “This is an era of 'everyone a rich second generation'. We criticise the rich second generation for their misbehaviour, yet in truth we are all practitioners of the rich second generation.

text: 现在很多父母，不管家里条件好还是坏，都陷入一个家庭教育的陷阱：
en: Nowadays many parents, whether well-off or not, fall into a trap of family education:

text: 再穷不能穷教育=再穷不能穷孩子。
en: Never let poverty starve education = never let poverty starve the child.

text: 哪怕自己月薪几千，压弯了脊梁，也要供孩子过富人家的生活。
en: Even on a monthly salary of a few thousand, bowing their backs, they still provide their child with the life of a wealthy family.

text: 带孩子吃高档西餐，自己啃白菜馒头；给孩子买上千的鞋，自己连件几十块的新衣服都不舍得买。
en: They take the child to eat fine Western meals while they themselves chew cabbage and steamed buns; they buy the child shoes costing over a thousand while begrudging a few dozen yuan for a new garment of their own.

text: 结果恰得其反，孩子没有变得上进，反而好逸恶劳，只图享受。
en: The result is the opposite — the child does not become ambitious, but instead grows idle and lazy, caring only for enjoyment.

text: 就像如今的朱单伟，他从始至终都像一个傀儡，一个麻木的啃老族。
en: Like Danwei Zhu today, he has been a puppet from start to finish, a numb sponger off his parents.

text: 结婚、生活方方面面靠的都是父母。
en: Marriage, and every aspect of daily life, rests on his parents.

text: 很难想象，没有了父亲大衣哥，他还能走得多远。
en: It is hard to imagine how far he could go without his father, Overcoat Brother.

text: 所谓“富养”，其实不是“砸钱去养”，而是让孩子自己变得很富足。
en: The so-called 'affluent nurturing' is not in fact 'raising a child with money', but letting the child become rich in spirit themselves.

text: 如何才能养出一个精神富足的孩子呢？
en: So how does one raise a child who is spiritually fulfilled?

text: 1. 富养孩子的“独立”
en: 1. Nurture the child's 'independence'

text: 世界上最富有的家族华顿家族，奉行的财富教育核心理念是“劳动让人有价值”。
en: The wealthiest family in the world, the Walton family, holds as its core principle of wealth education that 'labour gives a person worth'.

text: 老华顿从来不给孩子零用钱，他的孩子很小就开始打工赚钱，或在商店里擦地板，或帮忙修补仓库的房顶。
en: Old Walton never gave his children pocket money; from a very young age they began earning money through work, either mopping floors in the shop or helping mend the warehouse roof.

text: 易卜生说：“世界上最坚强的人就是独立的人。
en: Ibsen said: “The strongest person in the world is the independent person.”

text: 独立不仅是底气，也是孩子面对困难的勇气。
en: Independence is not only one's footing, but also a child's courage in the face of difficulty.

text: 2. 富养孩子的“阅历”
en: 2. Nurture the child's 'experience'

text: 曾经看过这样一个视频：凌晨 3 点，一个 14 岁的男孩玩着手机，不亦乐乎。
en: I once watched a video like this: at 3 a.m., a 14-year-old boy was playing on his phone, thoroughly enjoying himself.

text: 孩子爸爸没有生气，转头拉他出门去了街头和菜市场。
en: The boy's father did not get angry, but turned and took him out to the streets and the vegetable market.

text: 看着这群为生活打拼的人，儿子感悟到生活的不易，立马向爸爸道歉。
en: Watching these people striving for a living, the son realised how hard life is, and immediately apologised to his father.

text: 多带孩子看看外面的世界，丰富阅历，就更能让孩子明白父母的不易，对万事万物怀有一颗感恩之心。
en: Taking children to see the wider world and enriching their experience makes them all the more able to understand their parents' hardships, and to harbour gratitude towards all things.

text: 3. 富养孩子的“思想”
en: 3. Nurture the child's 'mind'

text: 在北京一个10㎡的房子里，蜗居着一家三口。
en: In a 10-square-metre room in Beijing lived a family of three.

text: 儿子睡在上铺，夫妻俩挤在下铺。
en: The son slept on the upper bunk, while the couple squeezed onto the lower one.

text: 很多人觉得这样的居住条件很压抑。
en: Many would find such living conditions stifling.

text: 但是小男孩从不抱怨，也不哭闹，反而乐在其中。
en: But the little boy never complained or cried, and instead took delight in it.

text: 家里没有电视，他就看书。
en: With no television at home, he read books.

text: 他的世界，并没有因为蜗居的环境变得狭隘和贫乏，反而因为书读得多了，变得广阔而丰盈。
en: His world did not grow narrow and barren because of the cramped surroundings; on the contrary, through reading widely it became broad and abundant.

text: 真正的“富养”，应该是对孩子精神世界的充分培养和灌溉。
en: True 'affluent nurturing' should be the full cultivation and watering of a child's inner world.

text: 而阅读是孩子丰富精神生活的源泉，在书中，孩子找到价值，开阔视野，提升自身的涵养。
en: And reading is the wellspring of a child's rich spiritual life; in books the child finds worth, broadens their horizons, and raises their own cultivation.

text: ▽知名主持人梁继璋给孩子的信里写道：
en: ▽ The well-known presenter Jizhang Liang wrote in a letter to his child:

text: “当你长大之后，我供养你的责任已经完结，以后你要坐巴士还是奔驰，吃鱼翅还是粉丝，都要自己负责。
en: “When you grow up, my responsibility to provide for you is fulfilled; whether you then take the bus or a Mercedes, eat shark's fin or vermicelli, will be for you to answer for.

text: 真正有远见的父母，其实心都有点硬，不会过早地让孩子随心所欲。
en: Truly far-sighted parents are in fact a little hard-hearted, and will not let their children have their way too early.
